title: Heartburn
description: Adds a few items made for a server im working on
body:
**The enchanted books for the heartburn can be found in many of the chests in the ancient cities**

**Guide:**  

- **Melee**: Melee is the most powerful ability of the heartburn, It halfes the hit entities health, so it would do the same amount of damage to a chicken as an iron golem, it cannot and will not one-shot anything. To keep it balanced it has a 1 minute cooldown. While on cooldown the melee only does 1 heart of damage to the hit entity.
  

- **Reach**: The reach enchantment adds the ability to teleport to the hit entity, Player  getting away? NO PROBLEM just hit them with a hit of any charge and teleport right on them!
 
- **Vertex**: Need an easy way to get around but you don't want to be in water or in the rain? The vertex enchantment has you covered! Just press and hold X while charging up and you get launched in the direction you're facing with no loss of hunger! you hunger bar does effect the max charge of this enchantment.

### And PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE report all bugs to: ### 
https://github.com/gunfulll/heartburn/issues
